database_note: The Invoice and InvoiceLine tables record sales events. Invoice tracks billing details per transaction, while InvoiceLine lists individual track purchases. The Track table describes audio files, linking to Album, Genre, and MediaType for context. Album connects to Artist to identify performers. Customer and Employee tables store contact and staff information, with Employee linking to itself via ReportsTo for hierarchy. Playlist and PlaylistTrack define music collections, with PlaylistTrack acting as a junction between playlists and tracks. Key joins include InvoiceLine connecting to Invoice via InvoiceId and to Track via TrackId. Album links to Artist via ArtistId. Track joins to Album, Genre, and MediaType via their respective IDs. Customer links to Invoice via CustomerId. Employee links to Customer via SupportRepId. Use these relationships to analyze sales, catalog, and organizational data.
